sources.entry: Day One - Excellent journaling app using text, photos, video, audio, location data, and more. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/day-one/id1055511498?platform=mac)

summary.name: Day One
summary.one_liner: Day One is a journaling app for capturing daily entries with text, photos, videos, drawings, and audio, available on iPhone, Android, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and the web.
use_cases: revisiting past entries on this day
backing up and exporting a journal
summary.what_it_does: Day One lets users write journal entries and add photos, videos, drawings, or audio recordings. The On This Day feature resurfaces entries from past years. Entries can be protected with passcodes or biometric security and are described as end-to-end encrypted with automatic backups. Users can export their data at any time. The journal can be accessed through the iPhone, Android, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch apps, or from any browser.
notable: On This Day feature for revisiting past entries
End-to-end encryption with passcode and biometric lock
Automatic backups with full data export
Award-winning design (App of the Year, Apple Design Award)
caveats: Page does not state which features require a paid tier, so pricing is listed as free only as the page describes the app as a free download
